material.acceptance_criteria: Owner decision recorded: consumers repointed to rust/data/rts with per-preset CI generate step, or root-sibling layout approved.
material.description:
Row: presets as directories (rust/data/moba, rust/data/rts, rust/data/rpg) loaded by one generator.
Fact: three live consumers read the rust/data root .star files directly and generate() reads direct children only (non-recursive, rust/crates/data/src/lib.rs:25-47). Moving the SC2 files to rust/data/rts leaves the root empty and each consumer fails with 'no grid() declared in the map' (validate.rs).
Consumers (remote main):
- rust/crates/spike/src/main.rs:53 osdt_data::generate(spike_dir/../../data) with ?, CI job check (ci.yml 'Run Lua mod spike').
- rust/gate/src/main.rs:15 generate(checks::data_dir()); rust/gate/src/checks.rs:154 data_dir()=rust/data; checks.rs:203 reads map.star at that root; CI job check (gate and gate mpq steps).
- rust/crates/mapexport/src/main.rs (generate(Path::new("data"))), CI job browser.
Witness gap: no CI step generates moba or rpg; ci.yml does not name rust/data/moba or rust/data/rpg, so the acceptance 'rust/data builds three presets' has no witness inside rust/data.
Ownership: rust/data only. The four files above (rust/crates/spike, rust/gate, rust/crates/mapexport, .github/workflows/ci.yml) are outside it.
Unblock (owner decision, one of): (a) a lane owning those consumers repoints them to rust/data/rts and adds a per-preset generate step to ci.yml, landed with or before the rts move; (b) the owner accepts rts staying at the root with moba and rpg as sibling directories, which departs from one directory per genre.
Evidence dispatch ids: 1792144142279-500-414a7058711f01a5 (data_dir), 1792144133799-500-34e19ae6d6999f2e (callers generate), 1792144245265-500-632dad897e861ab3 (ci.yml), 1792144252564-500-be39b6e471993d96 (spike), 1792144275212-500-c522b51bb848152d (mapexport). Receipts: .gm/receipts/engine-preset-data-loader/01-orient.md, 02-unknowns.md.
Working tree: local main 45 behind origin/main; 19 uncommitted paths under rust/data and rust/crates/data belong to another lane and were not touched. Publish would be Git API on remote tip.
material.resolution: Superseded by the no-hard-coded-genres decision and removal at 506bf54; replacement rows engine-mechanic-gates and engine-remove-genre-presets.
